mechanism: Both agents possess anticholinergic properties; benztropine is given to counteract extrapyramidal side effects of prochlorperazine, but combined anticholinergic effects increase risk of urinary retention, constipation, and CNS anticholinergic toxicity.
action: Monitor for anticholinergic adverse effects including urinary retention, constipation, confusion, and tachycardia; use lowest effective doses; ensure adequate hydration and consider stool softeners.
